# Notexia (notexia.in)

> Notexia is an AI-powered study platform for Indian students, engineering undergraduates, and competitive exam aspirants (JEE, NEET, GATE, CBSE).

## Core Capabilities
- **AI Study Assistant**: AI Notes Generator, PDF Textbook Summarizer, 24/7 Step-by-Step Doubt Solver, AI Revision Planner, and AI Flashcards.
- **Digital Study Notes**: Rich markdown note-taking with block LaTeX formulas (KaTeX), code blocks, and instant PDF/Markdown exports.
- **Free Student Tools**: Interactive formula sheets (Physics, Chemistry, Math, CS) and official university CGPA to Percentage converters.
- **Academic Community**: Public blog publishing platform, student Q&A forums, online study groups, and gamified batch leaderboards.

## Key Index & Public Structure
- [AI Study Tools](https://notexia.in/ai-study-tools): AI notes generator, PDF summarizer, doubt solver, and study planner.
- [Study Notes Directory](https://notexia.in/study-notes): Free digital study notes for Engineering, JEE, NEET, GATE, and CBSE.
- [Engineering Notes](https://notexia.in/study-notes/engineering): BTech semester notes for Computer Science, Electrical, Mechanical, and Civil.
- [JEE Study Notes](https://notexia.in/study-notes/jee): JEE Main & Advanced Physics, Chemistry, and Math notes.
- [NEET Study Notes](https://notexia.in/study-notes/neet): NCERT line-by-line revision notes for Biology, Physics, and Chemistry.
- [GATE Exam Notes](https://notexia.in/study-notes/gate): Short revision notes and formula sheets for GATE CS, EC, EE, ME, CE.
- [CBSE Study Material](https://notexia.in/study-notes/cbse): Class 10 & 12 board exam revision notes and NCERT solutions.
- [Free Tools Hub](https://notexia.in/tools): Calculators and interactive academic formula sheets.
- [Formula Sheets](https://notexia.in/tools/formula-sheets): Formula sheets for JEE, NEET, GATE, and BTech.
- [CGPA Converter](https://notexia.in/tools/cgpa-converter): CGPA to percentage converter for CBSE, VTU, KTU, Mumbai University, Anna University.
- [Public Blogs](https://notexia.in/blogs): Educational articles and research posts by scholars and educators.
- [Q&A Forums](https://notexia.in/forums): Academic discussion forum and student doubt resolution threads.
- [Student Community](https://notexia.in/community): Peer learning hub, online study groups, and scholar collaboration.
- [Leaderboard](https://notexia.in/leaderboard): Community contribution points and scholar rankings.

## Technology Stack
- Next.js 15 App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, TipTap, KaTeX, MongoDB Mongoose, Anthropic Claude & Google Gemini AI.
